warnings: หน้า05 (site_plan, A-03): x-axis setback labelled "A" (west+east of the property line, 1.00+9.60+1.00=11.60 inside a printed 15.60 total) carries NO printed number on this sheet - only the letter tag matching the legend note ("A = ระยะปรับตามขนาดที่ดินอย่างน้อย 2 ม."). Both ends of the 15.60 row are therefore left edge/edge - resolving them would require assuming the two gaps are equal, which is a guess, not a read. y-axis south setback IS printed as 3.00 under the tag "B", giving @-3.00 (A minus 3.00). The matching north gap has no number of its own, but the sheet also prints the 19.65 outer total and the 14.55 building total on the same row, so the north point closes by pure subtraction (19.65-14.55-3.00=2.10, i.e. @16.65 = F+2.10) - arithmetic on three printed numbers, not a guess, kept distinct from the x-axis case where two unknowns remain unresolved.

หน้า06 (floor_plan, A-04) is the sheet the master's own dummy-grid rationale already cites (1'/1''/3'/4'/E' all derived from A-04's printed sub-chains) - this sweep only adds what that earlier pass left out: the ST2 stair opening chain (0.40|2.70|0.10, x-axis, closes exactly to grid1->grid2, new points @0.40 and @3.10), two new south-of-A y points (@-1.60 under the ม้านั่ง/ST1 area - this is the exact "1.60 m strip south of grid A" the master's own DUMMY GRID RATIONALE note already names but deliberately left un-dummied under the pre-2026-09-27 rule; @-1.50 under the driveway ramp near grid3-4, a second, different point 0.10 m off from the first, both distances confirmed printed at 3x zoom, not misread), and the terrace bench chain C->@3.65->B (1.30|0.50), corroborated independently on the ST1 stair sheet (หน้า16). The terrace's OTHER (x-axis, 0.50|2.40|0.50) sub-chain could not be tied to a known line from this sheet alone and is left in unassigned_dimensions.

หน้า07 (roof_plan, A-05): the 1.30 m eave overhang beyond grid1/grid4 (x, giving @-1.30 and @10.90) and the 1.50 m eave overhang north of F (y, giving @16.05) are exactly the roof-edge lines the master's own DUMMY GRID RATIONALE / 'LINES DELIBERATELY NOT GIVEN DUMMY GRIDS' note names and explicitly declined to dummy under the pre-2026-09-27 rule ('every roof eave line ... carries no beam'). Rule 4 supersedes that per spec section 4: they get lines now. @4.65 (from grid B, 1.50 m) is the small entrance-canopy roof edge, independently reprinted on หน้า09/หน้า10/หน้า27 with the same value.

หน้า08 (A-06, รูปด้าน1+รูปด้าน2): the z-chain (reference/floor/roof_ridge = 0.00/0.60/3.75) is printed identically under both elevations - recorded as two occurrences, not deduplicated, per spec. รูปด้าน2's top-right 1.50 m (F->@13.05) is the shed-roof ridge's horizontal position measured INTO the building from grid F - a different point from the @16.05 eave overhang despite sharing the printed value 1.50; confirmed distinct by direction (this one measures toward E, the eave one measures away from the building, off the same F tick).

หน้า09 (A-07, รูปด้าน3 mirrored 4-3-2-1 + รูปด้าน4 A-B-C-D-E-F): รูปด้าน3's detailed row is the first sheet in this sweep to print the 0.30 sub-segment between 4'/1' and the roof edge explicitly (0.30+1.00+3.20+3.20+3.20+1.00+0.30=13.20, closing exactly against @-1.30/@10.90 already derived from หน้า07's cumulative 1.30 rows) - confirms those two placeholders precisely instead of leaving them as bare 1.30 cumulative jumps.

หน้า10 (A-08, รูปตัด1+รูปตัด2): z-chain adds two levels already present in the master's z_levels[] (source หน้า10, reviewer ids roof_apex_low +4.05 / roof_apex_high +5.05) but this sheet's own printed Thai labels for them are "ระดับหลังเสาล่าง" (+4.05) and "ระดับหลังเสาบน" (+5.05) - recorded here for the record only, not pushed into z_levels_add since the VALUES are not new, only their labels are. REAL DISCREPANCY, not resolved by this sweep: รูปตัด1's WC partition sub-chain reads 1.80|1.40 (grid4->@7.80->grid3), but the SAME wall position on the floor plan (หน้า06, A-04) reads 1.30|1.90 (grid3->3'@7.70->grid4) - a genuine 0.10 m disagreement between two sheets on what should be the same wall, both digit-checked at 3x zoom, neither blurry. This is exactly the class of mismatch gridfix's dry-run is meant to surface; recorded as two separate chains (not merged, not guessed) per spec - a human/gridfix-dry-run call is needed to decide whether 7.70 or 7.80 (or both, as two real but very close lines 0.10 m apart, just outside the 0.05 m near-duplicate tolerance) is correct.

หน้า12/13/14/15 (A-10/A-11/A-12/A-13, WC.1 & WC.2 plans+sections at 1:25): all four are labelled pattern "section"/"notes" in this house's own field-set (a pre-existing mislabel per spec section 1's own test - these are enlarged room PLANS/elevations with real grid-row callouts, the way house 02's equivalent WC pages are correctly patterned etc_plan; not corrected here, out of this sweep's scope) but ARE axis-bearing: each carries large-circle E/D row bubbles with an identical 0.10|0.90|0.90|0.10=2.00 breakdown (giving new points @10.45/@9.55/@8.65, all four sheets agreeing to the millimetre). Their x-direction dimensions (e.g. WC.1's 1.00|1.80 under a single lone grid-4 or grid-1 bubble, no second anchor) do not close against any second known line and are treated as local fixture/wall layout, not building-grid ticks - not transcribed into unassigned_dimensions either since they are genuinely single-anchor local dims, the same carve-out rule 4 gives a section's own width/depth.

หน้า16 (A-14, แปลนบันได ST.1 + รูปตัดบันได ST.1): this ม้านั่ง ค.ส.ล./เฉลียง bench structure sits in the B-C, grid2-3 bay and gives two new points, each confirmed twice on the same sheet (once in plan, once in section): @6.95 (x, grid3+0.55) and @3.65 (y, grid C-1.30, = grid B+0.50). Both digit-checked, not blurry. The plan's own bottom 0.50|2.40|0.50 chain does not close against either of these two new points or against the known 2-3/C-B spans and is left in unassigned_dimensions, same as หน้า06's copy of the same three numbers - likely the same real feature, still unresolved to a grid anchor.

หน้า17 (A-15, แปลนบันได ST.2 + รูปตัดบันได ST.2): the plan's top chain (0.10|0.40|2.70|0.10, over grid1-2's 3.20 bay) totals 3.30, 0.10 m more than the same-looking opening's 0.40|2.70|0.10=3.20 already resolved cleanly against grid1/grid2 on the floor plan (หน้า06). Rather than force either reading onto the other (or silently pick one), both are kept: หน้า06's version stays in dimension_chains (it closes exactly against the known bay width), หน้า17's four numbers go to unassigned_dimensions flagged with the discrepancy - a second real 'digit disagreement between two sheets' case alongside the หน้า10 WC-partition one above, both left for gridfix's dry-run / human review rather than guessed. The circled '6' on this sheet is a section-cut/detail callout marker (matching the 'ดูรายละเอียด' cross-reference convention used throughout this set), not a y-axis grid row - this house's rows run only A-F; not treated as a grid line. รูปตัดบันได ST.2's own riser/tread sub-dimensions (1.00|0.25|0.25, 0.90|0.60, EQ./EQ./EQ.) are element-internal stair-detail dimensions, not axis ticks, and were not transcribed further.

หน้า23/24/25/26/27 (S-02..S-06, the grid master's own cited source pages): print only the base named grid (1-2-3-4 @3.20, F-A breakdown, both cumulative totals) - no new dummy-worthy numbers beyond what the master already resolved from these exact sheets, except S-06 (หน้า27) which reprints the B->@4.65 (1.50 m) entrance-canopy marker also seen on หน้า07/09/10.

หน้า41/42 (SN-04/SN-05): sanitary MEP overlays reprint the full site-plan (SN-04, incl. the outer 15.60/19.65 property totals with the same unresolvable symbolic "A" gaps as หน้า05) and roof-plan (SN-05, incl. the eave/canopy dummies from หน้า07) dimension sets verbatim - recorded as their own occurrences per source_image, not deduplicated.

หน้า49/50/51 (EE-03/EE-04/AC-fan): electrical/AC overlays reprint the same site-plan grid+property-line set as SN-04. หน้า49 and หน้า50 were individually image-read and confirmed matching หน้า05/หน้า41's numbers exactly; หน้า51 (AC/fan plan) was NOT individually re-opened - its entry above is included by strong inference from 6/6 other MEP overlay sheets in this set showing identical grid dimensioning, not from a fresh pixel read of หน้า51 itself. Flagged honestly rather than silently skipped or silently asserted as verified.

SCOPE NOTE: this sweep prioritized building-grid-axis chains (the margin/header dimension stacks tying to x_lines/y_lines/z_levels) and did not exhaustively transcribe every element-internal number on every sheet (door/window leaf sizes, individual fixture mounting heights e.g. +1.20M outlet heights, riser/tread dimensions, rebar/bend callouts) into unassigned_dimensions - those are member/fixture-own details, exempted by rule 4's own carve-out ('a dimension inside one element's own detail... stays on the element as it always has'). Numbers that WERE genuinely ambiguous axis-adjacent chains (couldn't be confidently tied to a known line, not clearly element-internal either) were put in unassigned_dimensions rather than silently dropped, per spec.
